text: APPROVE. The patch moves the label, bracket and trailing-operator checks into `TryFindArrayLiteral` with the same conditions, and `open` and `close` reach the rest of the method via `out`. That should cut roughly five points of complexity from the remaining method, well under 15, and I see no compile problems. The diff doesn't show the rest of the original method body, so I'm assuming it doesn't use the moved `at` or `after` locals.
